name: Cercle
author: Cercle contributors
description: Shares your listening with your Cercle circles (self-hosted social hub)

hub_url.title: Hub URL
hub_url.description: Base URL of your Cercle hub as reachable from Navidrome, e.g. http://cercle-hub:8080/hub. Events are posted to <hub_url>/ingest/v1/events.

users.reason: Receive scrobble events for the users assigned to this plugin and show their display name in Cercle

http.reason: Send listening events to your Cercle hub (usually on a private network, so any host is allowed)

subsonicapi.reason: Look up album id, artist id, year and genre of the playing track (getSong), which Navidrome does not pass to scrobblers

cache.reason: Cache per-track metadata and user display names to avoid repeated lookups
